description: apm-stage account 985408759551 unblended spend over the last N days vs the $2,000/day SLO ceiling. Use for stage leak, staging burn, or 985408759551 questions.

configuration.query:
FROM metrics-aws.billing-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_DATEPERIOD(CONCAT(TO_STRING(?days), " days"))
    AND aws.billing.group_definition.key == "LINKED_ACCOUNT"
    AND cloud.account.id == "985408759551"
| STATS spend = SUM(aws.billing.UnblendedCost.amount)
| EVAL lookback_days = ?days::integer
| EVAL avg_daily = spend / lookback_days
| EVAL daily_slo_ceiling_usd = 2000
| EVAL over_slo = avg_daily > daily_slo_ceiling_usd
